svg.title: Final regression corrections
svg.desc: Attendance was timing-sensitive, rather than a request-generation defect. With UMBRA_IDLE=30, a 7.5-second heartbeat left only 0.5 seconds before the fixture expired. A controlled 2.8-second pause of only the disposable profile's daemon reproduced logout while WebKit kept running. Dividing the short-idle cadence by eight gives an earlier heartbeat; the kept host survives the same delay and the unkept host logs out. The normal 900-second idle setting remains capped at the existing 15-second cadence. Five unchanged attendance/resting tests pass.
